findings: SubscriptionGuard not yet applied to any route — guard infrastructure exists and is registered, but no endpoint uses @RequiredPlan(). API is fully open to plan-tier abuse until premium endpoints are decorated with @UseGuards(FirebaseAuthGuard, SubscriptionGuard) @RequiredPlan('renter_pro') (or appropriate tier).

setPendingPlan swallowed catch (pre-existing, out of scope) — inner try/catch {} on Firestore write was present before FEAT-001 and was not addressed. A write failure silently returns { success: true } to the client. Fix separately: remove the inner catch and let the error propagate, matching the downgradeToFree pattern.

loginAsMockUser not DEV-guarded (possible) — loginAsMockUser in AuthContext.tsx has no import.meta.env.DEV guard, only the onAuthStateChanged mock-token path does. Reachability depends on whether consuming components are tree-shaken in prod builds; not verified in this review.
